extras_and_delay#ext_lineup_vintage.rationale: Lineup, probable-pitcher, roof and postponement inputs are already named in the record; what is missing is a timestamped history of announcements, which only prospective own-capture of the MLB Stats API/news feed for a season supplies.

first5_markets#f5_trip_penalty_variation.rationale: The TTO/second-look input is already in the catalog; whether its size is pitcher-specific by arsenal or league-wide and whether it shifted after 2023 is an effect-size question for 2021+ Statcast analysis.

first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_misf.rationale: Records defect: mlb.f3_split, mlb.tto and the PA dataset still carry F3/F5 content from a superseded filing, so the input list of the archetype is wrong for KXMLBRFI, KXMLBINNINGTOTAL and KXMLBINNINGWIN.
first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_misf.catalog_action: Edit first_inning_and_inning_markets: strip F3/F5-specific content from mlb.f3_split, mlb.tto and the PA dataset, keep only inputs serving RFI/INNINGTOTAL/INNINGWIN, and list live inning strikes from the series ledger.

first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_spli.rationale: The chain already models first-trip PA outcomes; whether a residual first-inning pitcher skill exists is a variance-decomposition test on play-by-play, not missing catalog information.

game_moneyline#ml_hfa_mechanism.rationale: The HFA input is named; splitting it into last-at-bat versus park/travel components and testing a post-2023 regime shift is a magnitude estimate on Retrosheet/Stats API data.

game_total_and_team_total#tot_park_axis_.rationale: wind_vector_park is defined and needs park bearing and wall geometry; the gap is only that no verified source table is named, a source question (stadium coordinates/diagrams), not a missing input or mechanism.

game_total_and_team_total#tot_postseason.rationale: Verified: the automatic extra-inning runner remains regular-season only and the 2026 postseason used bases-empty extras (MLB/CBS/NBC reports), so the regime input is unchanged; what is left is whether Kalshi totals count extra-inning runs, contract wording only.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_bvp_sam.rationale: Platoon and pitch-type matchup inputs are both already named; whether a shrunk matchup term beats platoon-only is a held-out comparison and shrinkage-constant question settled by data analysis.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_hrr_cha.rationale: Missing interaction: KXMLBHRR's runs and RBI components lack the lineup-neighbour base-out chain (pa_base_out_state_chain) that the RBI archetype defines, so the hits record's input list is incomplete for HRR.
hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_hrr_cha.catalog_action: Define one shared pa_base_out_state_chain input and attach it to hitter_hits_and_total_bases for KXMLBHRR's runs/RBI legs, mirroring hitter_rbis_runs_sb.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_regime_.rationale: The rule changes and outcome model are named; whether the model is stable across the 2023 shift-ban/base-size regime is a by-season calibration check, and a regime indicator is a fitting choice, not missing information.

hitter_home_runs#hr_opp_starter_change.rationale: Missing input: the HR ladder evaluates pitcher_hr_vulnerability for the announced starter only and has no probable-pitcher-change input, although a scratch of the opposing starter does not trigger fair price.
hitter_home_runs#hr_opp_starter_change.catalog_action: Attach the shared probable-pitcher-change input (from first5_markets) to hitter_home_runs and redefine pitcher_hr_vulnerability as a mixture over announced and replacement starters.

hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_runs_scope.rationale: Series/archetype mapping defect: the record's scope claims runs scored though no runs-scored series is filed, and only KXMLBRBI and KXMLBSB belong to it, so scope and inputs disagree with the filed series.
hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_runs_scope.catalog_action: Revise hitter_rbis_runs_sb scope to KXMLBRBI and KXMLBSB, drop runs-scored inputs unless the series ledger shows a runs ladder, and confirm KXMLBSB filing versus counting specials.

hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_sb_battery_timin.rationale: sb_context and its inputs are defined; the open point is whether Savant publicly exposes pitcher time-to-plate and per-play pop time, a source-availability limitation with named proxies as fallback.

hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_sb_green_light.rationale: The team attempt-rate input is named; within-season persistence of attempt-per-opportunity and manager-change effects are shrinkage and update-horizon constants for data analysis.

offfield_markets#off_eoty_electorate.rationale: Stale pointer: no offfield_markets input depends on it. Verified the electorate (MLB Executive of the Year, voted by executives of all 30 clubs at the start of the postseason); what remains is that individual ballots are not published.

offfield_markets#off_unstaged_inputs.rationale: Records defect: inputs for series that left offfield_markets (sale stage hazard, manager award score, esports rating, manager candidate signal) remain attached and would be integrated into the wrong archetype.
offfield_markets#off_unstaged_inputs.catalog_action: Detach sale-stage hazard, manager award score, esports rating and manager candidate signal from offfield_markets and attach each to the archetype now holding its series.

pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks#erhw_join.rationale: The H/BB/ER ladders and batters-faced coupling are named; choosing between a copula, shared latent and BF-coupled joint model is a model-comparison exercise on start-level data.

pitcher_outs#outs_constants.rationale: Pitches per PA, pitch caps, out probability and the outs 19-20 pull claim are uncited constants of an already-specified mechanism; fitting them from 2021-2025 start logs is calibration.

pitcher_outs#outs_exit_lattice_stability.rationale: Manager exit lattices are already an input; their cross-season persistence and the manager shrinkage constant are split-half estimates on public start logs.

pitcher_outs#outs_hazard_naming.rationale: Definition defect: the starter exit hazard is defined three times (sp_workload/leash, sp_hook_hazard_curve, exit_boundary_mass) across sibling archetypes, which would be fitted separately and drift apart.
pitcher_outs#outs_hazard_naming.catalog_action: Author one shared starter exit-hazard input id and remap sp_workload, sp_hook_hazard_curve and exit_boundary_mass in pitcher_strikeouts, pitcher_outs and pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks to it.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_latent_state_size.rationale: The within-start latent dispersion input is named; whether its correlation is material by arsenal type is a magnitude estimate on held-out pitch-level data.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_shape_constants.rationale: The TTO input is named; its functional form (step vs per-batter gradient), 0.15-0.40 magnitudes and 1 mph threshold are shape/constant fitting on 2021-2025 play-by-play.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_talent_prior_gap.rationale: Missing input: pitcher talent has no stuff-model or projection K% prior, so arsenal changes, injury returns and rookies have no defined information source where whiff samples are thinnest.
pitcher_strikeouts#ks_talent_prior_gap.catalog_action: Add a pitcher K% prior input to pitcher_strikeouts (pitch-model stuff grade or ZiPS/Steamer projection) with source and blending rule versus k_rates and pitch_type_whiff.

player_participation#pp_opp_starter_vint.catalog_action: Define an opposing-probable-starter input (identity, throwing hand, announcement timestamp) and attach it to the player_participation manager-decision stage.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_electorate.rationale: Verified electorates differ: Rivera/Hoffman by a six-reliever panel, Hank Aaron by Hall of Fame panel plus fan vote, Comeback by 30 MLB.com beat reporters. One shared Plackett-Luce model is wrong; inputs differ (fan-vote term).
season_leaders_and_awards#lea_electorate.catalog_action: Split season_leaders_and_awards award models by electorate: add fan-vote input for Hank Aaron, panel/beat-writer models for Reliever and Comeback, citing each body's procedure.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_eoty_elect.rationale: Verified: MLB Executive of the Year is voted by executives of all 30 clubs at the start of the postseason, with no public ballots, so the BBWAA-style rank model, public-ballot and manager win-over-expectation inputs do not apply.
season_leaders_and_awards#lea_eoty_elect.catalog_action: Rewrite KXMLBEOTY inputs in season_leaders_and_awards: executive-voter model on front-office/team-improvement signals, removing public-ballot and manager inputs.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_narrative_.catalog_action: Define narrative flags (milestone, comeback, first-year, position scarcity) with tagging rules and sources as a concrete input of the award vote-share models.
